end.summary: Reyansh showed how a solid can look from the top, front and side, including a ball, cone and cylinder.
end.parentNote: Asha practised top, front and side views with Reyansh using balls, cups, books and other objects. They matched several views to objects and later corrected the idea that someone in another place sees the same view; the idea that an object looks the same from every side still needs checking. At home, place a cup or toy in different positions and ask Reyansh to draw only the parts visible from each place.
